result:
Round 235 (SABA-B-11a stage 2) is implemented, with no STOP. With a tempo set, the bars ruler is now interactive: a click on its 10 px top strip starts playback from that point. A click below the strip moves the playhead, a drag scrolls or zooms, and a double-click fits the project. Without a tempo the bars ruler behaves exactly as before. C has not verified anything yet, so none of this is a PASS.

**Scope:** exactly the 8 granted files changed plus the 3 new ones: the hook `app/hooks/useRulerNavigation.ts`, the test file `bars-ruler-ui.test.tsx`, and doc 183. The frozen-file, root-file and protected-file checks all pass (rc 0), and doc 182 changed on line 4 only. The seconds ruler's gesture code moved into the new hook unchanged, and both rulers use it now. The strip-vs-lower zone is decided by which element the press started on, not by a pixel height.

**Checks run:**
- `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, Biome on the 9 changed code files and `npm run lint` all pass with no errors.
- The B-listed covering test set passed: 108 files, 1,624 tests. That run came before my last two test additions; the new test file alone then passed 12/12.
- No test is above 50 % of its timeout. The closest is LRS4 at 2,488 ms of 5,000 ms (1,625 ms at gate 234).
- **Mutants** (each applied, run against the final 12 tests, then reverted):
  - MU-B (strip seeks instead of playing): 5 tests fail, including BR2 and BR3.
  - MU-C (handlers attached without a tempo): BR1 fails.
  - MU-D (extra: a cancelled press counted as a click): BR6 fails.
  - MU-MEMO (extra: the gestures object not memoised): the existing render-count tests BU8 and render-budget stay green, so they never guarded this. I added BR11 for it, and it turns red.
- **Code-reviewer subagent:** 8/10. From its findings I fixed one doc sentence and added cancel coverage plus BR11. Three test gaps remain: no test when pointer capture throws, none for a past-end strip click while playing, and none for touch.
- **Playwright on :5173, both viewports, 0 page errors.** The before-screenshots were taken before any edit. Every recipe matched B's expected values:
  - strip click while stopped plays from 4.000;
  - strip click while playing jumps to 8.000 and keeps playing;
  - lower-zone click gives 6.5, and with Alt 6.3;
  - a 200 px drag scrolls by 200;
  - the Fit status, and the past-end and empty-project messages, are exact;
  - without a tempo, nothing reacts.

**Needs a B ruling:** the reviewer raised a Medium, A-R235-REVIEW-M1. When starting playback from the strip, the code checks the rendered `isPlaying` value, while `togglePlayback` checks its own ref. If the two ever differ, a strip click could only seek, or could stop playback. I never saw this happen. B's §2.3 design specifies this exact check, and nothing that existed before changed, so it is not a STOP. The fix is a context `playFrom(time)`, which needs `ArrangementContext.tsx` (frozen now). Round 236 already has that file granted.

**Not run by me (C's rows):** the audio RMS check, the ±50 ms timing judgement, the `?` sheet in the browser, the screen-text line count, the loop and library-preview neighbours, a Performance trace, and touch.

**Architecture note for B (proposal only, nothing moved):**
- The new hook imports `watchUncapturedPointerGesture` from a component file. The reviewer suggests moving it to `app/lib/arrangement/pointer-gesture.ts`.
- The Overview keeps its own copy of the drag logic. The reviewer says keep it for now.

I deleted my own interim checkpoint `a-round-235.md` and rewrote it as the final report; nothing else was deleted. No commits or pushes. The full report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-235.md`, with logs, screenshots and scripts in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-235/`.
